blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) on Thursday warned of possible further diplomatic action as it rebuked the Chinese Embassy for its social media attacks against Philippine officials and lawmakers, saying these undermined efforts to improve relations between Manila and Beijing. The DFA described the embassy’s latest online remarks as “escalatory and undiplomatic,” while reaffirming the Philippines’ adherence to its One China Policy amid Beijing’s accusations that Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. was challenging the principle. “The escalatory and undiplomatic tone and language used in the latest social media statements of the Chinese Embassy erode mutual trust and […]...
